items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: I worked in California in Stockton, up in Stockton, at a colored nightclub. Stockton, Illinois, for Mr. Finley.

ctx.x: And all the time you could be pretty independent about it, because there's plenty to do back home if you ever decided not to. Yeah.

And my husband wasn't particular about me traveling around too much, you know. He wanted me to be home most of the time. I, uh, went to California. I worked in California in Stockton, up in Stockton, at a colored nightclub. Stockton, Illinois, for Mr. Finley. I've even forgot the name of the club. Been so long. That's when I left Carol Dickerson's orchestra. Went out there. And stayed four months.
Well, now let's see. Where does Dickerson fit in? We didn't manage to fit him in here correctly. Was he after Panama and Golden Pheasant?
